title: debug_assert for empty outbox_peers silently no-ops in release builds
description: insert_outbound_message uses debug_assert!(!outbox_peers.is_empty()) to guard against an empty peer slice. In release builds the assert is compiled out; an empty slice creates a Pending message with no outbox row, so the retry loop never fires and the message is permanently stuck. The guard must be a real error return, not a debug assertion.
